# Hi, I'm Salva!

[![GameDev](https://img.shields.io/badge/GameDev-000000?style=for-the-badge)](#)

I'm a **technologist specializing in Learning & Language technologies** and a **narrative designer passionate about crafting immersive experiences**, based in Barcelona, Spain.

### **Current Projects**

I am the **Head of Educational Technology and Translation** at [Fundación Universitaria Iberoamericana (FUNIBER)](https://www.funiber.org/), where I work at the intersection of **technology, learning, and language** and lead projects that aim to **enhance education through digital tools**. I am also exploring ways to integrate **game development** and **gamification** into educational technology.

You can find my software projects here on GitHub, as well as on [ragart-uoc](https://github.com/ragart-uoc) for my academic work, and on [funiber-edtech](https://github.com/funiber-edtech) for my professional projects in educational technology and translation.

### **Education**

[![UPF](https://img.shields.io/badge/Translation%20and%20Interpreting%20%40%20UPF-2004/08-c8102e?style=for-the-badge&logo=data:image/png;base64,&logoColor=white)](https://www.upf.edu/)

[![UOC](https://img.shields.io/badge/Game%20Design%20and%20Programming%20%40%20UOC-2023/24-73edff?style=for-the-badge&logo=data:image/png;base64,&logoColor=white)](https://www.uoc.edu/)

[![THU & King Mentorship Program](https://img.shields.io/badge/THU%20&%20King%20Mentorship%20Program-2024/25-fe6d09?style=for-the-badge&logo=data:image/png;base64,&logoColor=white)](#)

I have a **Bachelor's Degree in Translation and Interpreting** from [Universitat Pompeu Fabra (UPF)](https://www.upf.edu/) and a **Master's Degree in Game Design and Programming** from [Universitat Oberta de Catalunya (UOC)](https://www.uoc.edu/).

I was also part of a **Mentorship Program** with [Trojan Horse was a Unicorn](https://www.trojan-unicorn.com/) and [King](https://www.king.com/), where I had the opportunity to work with industry professionals and gain insights into game development and design.

### **Skills**

I primarily work with **Unity** and **C#**, but I can navigate 
**Godot**, **Unreal**, and other engines as well. I also have experience with **Twine**, **Ren'Py**, and interactive fiction tools. You can check out my **[itch.io page](https://ragart.itch.io/)** for games I’ve made as part of my education or just for fun. Recently, I've been diving into low-level graphics with **WebGPU** and **WebGL**, building 3D web experiences with **Three.js**, and exploring **RayLib**.

Beyond game development, I work extensively with **PHP**, **Python**, and **JavaScript**. I have experience with frameworks like **Laravel** and **Lumen**, and I’ve also worked with **Flask**. My day-to-day involves working with **Moodle** and other learning management systems, developing plugins and integrations to enhance the learning experience. Additionally, I work with **Dataiku**, **MySQL**, **MariaDB** and **data analysis**, managing workflows and optimizing datasets for better insights. I also automate workflows using **n8n**.
